pc.title: Gill
pc.content: Gill the triton artificer came to the festival to explore the city and see what inventions can be made. He met Elly and from there joined the party in the quest for the Celestial Droplet. He likes to watch Riven perform by the seaside from afar while he puts the puzzle in his head together. The magic effecting Gill seems to be a topic banned by the Celestials. (Corey's notes also mention Gill may have been raised by someone named Meryll.)

pc.title: Corelia Harrendyl
pc.content: Aasimar Samurai Fighter, a friend of Mozzie the devil, currently looking for an item that used to belong to her family. Helped integrate Gill. She has also been hearing voices: "Return the final piece, and reawaken the ship."

pc.title: Riven
pc.content: The sea elf bard that cannot go into the sea, likely because of a curse from some kind of being/god. He loves the sea, but the sea does not love him; bad things happen if he enters the water. He was once part of a troupe with Elly and Blue (possibly childhood friends), now bartends at the Royal Seadog, and seems connected to information/criminal circles. The person tied to the curse may have been someone he loved named Lori. He has not been home for around 100 years because of this.

pc.title: Rahkar
pc.content: Student of Talon Malsear. Originally from the Shadowfell. May have Nobel Heirtigdge, unsure. Hears voices in his head and is prone to spontaneous teleporting. There are signs someone cursed his bloodline to inhibit magical abilities; may be tied to a cursed prophecy. Raven King apparently tried to warn his family. Parents are dead.

pc.title: Blue
pc.content: Sapphire dragonborn bard (Blue/Tiff, with Tiff seeming to be a personal name). Was once part of a troupe with Riven and Elly. Alandra said it feels like two people are constantly present around Blue, and Blue's dreams are very present: "Someone is constantly betraying you, and they don't know it themselves." There may be family ties to someone named Abi Asmur (amethyst dragonborn with silver eyes) connected to piano lessons.

npc.title: Talon Malsir
npc.content: One of the great heroes, a wild-magic sorcerer who helped defeat the Pale Silence, now a resident celebrity living in Alsicta; mentor/master of Rahkar. Father of Soren Malsir. Seems to have issues, best not to press. At one point he encountered the dragonborn known as the Golden Flame (possibly the original golden dragonborn). He also publicly announced the hunt for the Celestial Droplet on behalf of Alsita's government.

npc.title: Unknown Captain of the Riverwalker/Former
npc.content: Seen in a vision (the same one Corelia saw). Going by an alias right now, cannot remember his name. His first mate is not here (the other one in the vision). Remembers vaguely the man he traveled with and believes his friend was not a good person. Was able to sense some sort of magic from Blue and Riven, then associated it with Gill. He and Gill are on much better terms now.

npc.title: Hubert
npc.content: Hobo, friend of Blue, old man who lived in the alleyway with Blue. Former sailor with naval experience and now acting captain of the party ship.

npc.title: jonik
npc.content: The wood elf whom we met at the inn. Ask Riven about his opinion on current events. Part of the High Council and head of military. Was once effected by a white tentical.

npc.title: The Golden Flame
npc.content: TACOS, HE'S A MEXICAN. Owns a mansion. Fights. Wants a cape that does not belong to him; this cape seems to have belonged to the orginal Golden Flame.

npc.title: High council of pinchchester
npc.content: Jonik is part of this group (and appears to serve as military leadership).

npc.title: Thea
npc.content: A paladin. A triton. A wife. Can communcate with souls (per Mia). Co-author/annotator of The Big Book with Shelly.

npc.title: Shelly
npc.content: A terrorist. Wrote The Big Book. Wife of Thea. Gill is a big fan of her because of her book and inventions.

npc.title: Mira Dahlien
npc.content: Matriarch of the Dahlien Family. She co-owns the Wayfarer Tavern with her husband Akris, and her family works there alongside her and the demon Mozzie. Family order (oldest to youngest): Elazar, Pride, Euphie, Pura, Sol. Mira asked Corelia to look after Nero and see if he will come home one day.

npc.title: The orginal Golden Flame
npc.content: A long time ago there was a hero known as the Golden Flame, a golden dragonborn. We do not know much about this man, but we do know he fought the hero known as Talon. A statue of him stands in the Tomb of Rememberance.

npc.title: Gate crasher
npc.content: Fist of the golden mountain. Friend of Jonik. Connected to Jonik's catacomb request; his remains were tied to the requested weapon retrieval.

npc.title: tom riddle(Rhaekar main voice)
npc.content: The main voice in Rhaekar's head; he may be in the Vault of Rindos.

event.title: DREAM BATTLES
event.content: For some reason, in Riven's dreams, he has been dragging party members into his dreams to fight some sort of shadow demon. Currently, Coreila and Rahkar have been sent into these dreams. Mozzie showed up to Coreila aid, and Rahkar got a boost from his voices in his head. Xim described Riven's dreams as terrifying and almost alive.

event.title: The quest from jonik
event.content: Jonik has certain access to things: under the city they buried the honored dead (sewers/catacombs), with offerings and treasure in the Tomb of Remeberance. He wanted something returned to him, a rapier, and warned us about undead and cave-ins. We would find a locked gate connected to Gate Crasher. The rapier is with the body of Gate Crasher.

enemy.title: Shadow Demon
enemy.content: WHAT THE FUCK WAS THAT, IT WAS AFTER BLUE AND RIVEN AND SARAH AS THEY BROKE SOMEWHERE IT WAS SCARY, IDK. Might be connected to the recurring dream/nightmare attacks around Riven.

enemy.title: Dreadtooth
enemy.content: A famous pirate who hunts those who make deals with him. He cuts ships in half. He made a deal with Elly and is now looking to talk with Gill. Arron (they/them) seems to work for/with him. He is described as someone who claims to be part of the sea and may control tides/shores with his vessel and sword. Not clearly tied to the Golden Circle.

enemy.title: Rindos
enemy.content: An ancient black dragon attacking the contintent; has many worshippers and a cult. Followers include fanatics like Zalbog of the Black Blessing.

enemy.title: Weird slimy thing
enemy.content: A slimy enemy; Mozzie took the enemy. He and his kind appeared during the Pale Silence, as remembered by Riven. We first found this enemy in Pinchchester, in the Tomb of Rememberance.

location.title: The royal seadog
location.content: A bar in Alsicta. Riven bartends here and uses it as an information/contact spot.

location.title: Gildhammer
location.content: There was an illitid problem. Draves. Also noted as Godrian's original home.

location.title: the tomb of remeberance
location.content: Catacombs under the city of Pinchester. In one room there are four statues in the corners: one for the Golden Flame, one for the hero known as the Tempest (destroyed), one known as the Matrearch (Riven seems to react to this statue like he knew her), and one that looks like Former. In one room lies a picture of a snake with wings.

location.title: Pinchchester
location.content: The city of heros. Connected to the High Council, Jonik, and the Tomb of Rememberance missions.

item.title: Celestial Droplet
item.content: Only rumors at this point. Some relate it to a kids' book. Some attribute it to the dragon that attacked, which could place it in Alsita, or that the government stole it. 1 million gp bounty. Droplet with blue and purple tints, emanates energy of storm clouds and arcana, with magical and religious importance. Orphon linked it to post-Pale Silence shifts in River of Souls beliefs and free will theology.

item.title: Random Monolith
item.content: Some form of ward/protection. The language cannot be understood. Rhaekar's mind is clear when he's there.

item.title: White tentacle
item.content: Not much is known about this tentacle other than it was from the time of the Pale Silence; it was housed in the church but was removed from its case and taken toward Pinchester. The dragon Rindos seems interested in it. The government is willing to pay 5000 gold per adventuring party to keep it safe and its secret kept.

item.title: Dagger that steal souls
item.content: It can steal and store souls. Right now there is a soul loose in Alsita. Was once asked to use this weapon against the demon known as Mozzie.

item.title: ellie dreadtooth ipad
item.content: A tablet that belongs to Elly and allows communication to Dreadtooth. Gill touched it and now Dreadtooth is looking for him.

item.title: Party Crasher
item.content:
Weapon (light hammer), (requires attunement)

Hidden in the rubble of the Tomb of Remembrance, Partycrasher is an expertly forged hammer engraved with goblin scripture. The hammer flies through the air with overwhelming force when thrown, being especially effective against structures and constructs.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You may make a ranged weapon attack with this weapon as a bonus action so long as the weapon isn't currently equipped. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra 1d4 Force damage, or an extra 4d4 Force damage if the target is a Construct. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon reforms back in your hand (or wherever it was thrown from).

Sentience. Partycrasher is a sentient lawful neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 11, a Wisdom of 16, and a Charisma of 15. It has hearing and darkvision out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak both Common and Goblin. While attuned or holding it, the wielder gains the ability to speak, read and understand Goblin.

Happy Weapon, happy Warrior

item.title: The big book
item.content: A book co-authored by Thea and Shelly (Shelly handled the science and Thea annotated). Currently it is in the possession of Gill. It may include relevant notes on deep-ocean beings, gods/goddesses, and possible Soulsong context.
